# Frontend Design

Build UI around one memorable idea and disciplined fundamentals.

1. Decide what draws the eye first; one dominant element per screen.
2. Two fonts only, sized on a fixed step scale.
3. Few colors: neutral base, brand hue, single action accent.
4. Consistent spacing rhythm; keep reading lines 45-75 characters.
5. Keyboard paths, visible focus, contrast checked before polish.
6. Compare the finished screen against the direction note; cut noise.
